name: Takiko Uchiyama
source:
The youngest prisoner and the nation's sweetheart. Appearing on weather shows, talk shows and in various documentaries you can't escape the constant positive vibes of 'Japan's Sister'. People follow her social media religiously for her positive self affirmations and general optimistic outlook on life.

She's seemingly entered work-mode since coming to the lab, doing what she can to cheer others up and listen to their issues and worries. Which has made her a comforting presence for some prisoners and really annoying to other prisoners.

Despite her positive attitude she seemingly has no remorse for her crime, almost seeming proud of it when interrogated. She doesn't believe she's done anything wrong.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Takiko_Uchiyama]Wiki[/url]]
